blends.name: Nature Primordial Spirit
blends.desc:
The first Pixel City already existed when the first pixelers arrived and took it as their home, but no one knows which civilization lived there before. Pixelers started to move in and became modest farmers, working the lands to feed themselves and others. Curiosity and prosperity attracted even more people to the emerging reality, and the first collectors started searching the outskirts of Pixel City for treasures and resources. Life was good, but too simple for many. Once all that was new became routine, Pixelers began to feel the need to connect with higher purposes, and some, with sharp awareness, started trying to make sense of their reality. This led to the creation of the Magic Guild.
The Magic Guild arose from curiosity for the unknown, the same curiosity that unconsciously led sensitive Pixelers to search for sources of power and energy in nature. The first Pixelers admired the those energetic manifestations with wonder and respect, knowing that these forces were responsible for maintaining balance in the universe, but this slowly changed when the Magic Guild was created. The boldest and most passionate magic researchers began searching for ways to tap into that energy, not just to alleviate the loneliness of a still-manifesting world, but also out of genuine, yet naive, interest. Soon, the Magic Guild researchers discovered one of the sources of power, right beneath their feet.
In the magical chambers beneath Pixel City, the first Slimes were discovered. These cute, round creatures quickly became popular among Pixelers, who started playing and training them. Slimes got along well with humans because both had a playful nature. The breeding and study of these magical creatures led to the creation of stronger Slimes, but as the naivety and innocence faded, it gave way to lust and a thirst for power. The Slimes changed along with humans, as they were no longer seen as friends and companions, but as tools.
As the breeding of more Slimes exhausted the magical essence, their power weakened. When the Slimes realized they were being used as tools, not friends, strange and unpredictable things started to happen. The power of love faded and was replaced by a love of power, and bizarre forms of energy began to manifest. All those mixed feelings gave shape to the First Primordial Spirits that demand Pixelers to sacrifice some of their wealth in a promise for a bigger power!
